# recruiter-eval-workspace-agent

> Technical-recruiter agent bundle — drafts JDs, designs structured screening rubrics, and composes interview loops. Hard-refuses any input or inference about protected-class attributes (race / gender / age / national-origin / disability). Hiring decisions stay with humans; the agent produces artifacts (`:::artifact`) the hiring team reviews, edits, and signs off on. Demonstrates the agent-runtime substrate composing with structured-output-blocks on the Tangle floor for a moderate-stakes operations workflow.

## Stack
- Family: agent-runtime-recruiter-ts
- Layers: agent-base:tangle, agent-base:secure, agent-base:privacy, agent-output:blocks, agent-base:memory, agent-base:scheduler, agent-base:mcp-registry, agent-channels:telegram, agent-channels:discord, agent-channels:slack, agent-channels:whatsapp, agent-channels:imessage, agent-channels:gmail, agent-channels:linear
